name: Craft
purpose: Coordinate the owner-controlled development, testing, migration, and evolution of the Product formerly named DomainSpec v2 under its current Craft name through CAV2-D20 Craft Method.
scope: the stable Craft Project identity and its owner routes
the separate CA2-PRODUCT-CRAFT Product and its draft Product Thesis
same-Product-lineage continuity from the former DomainSpec v2 name to Craft
exact migration of legacy DomainSpec-v2 source, implementation, and authority paths
CAV2-D20 Craft Method as the Product's system-building method
candidate Product Features contextualized by the Craft Product
the preservation and classification of finished DomainSpec capabilities and in-development assets
future product ontology, system architecture, construction, conformance, runtime evidence, and migration goals
exclusions: collapsing Craft Product, Project, Method, Product Feature, Product Capability, public capability, or ledger state
treating the project-local Product Feature term as canonically admitted
treating the naming decision as evidence that legacy paths, imports, consumers, or authority bindings already moved
deleting DomainSpec-v2 sources before dependency-closed migration and preservation evidence
collapsing the private Craft Project with the public Arcanum craft capability or .craft state
implementation, publication, release, deployment, or external effects
owner_routes: DomainSpec v2 owner until a separately accepted adoption transfers responsibility
challenge_route: Challenge Product meaning through the Craft Product owner, Project coordination through the Craft Project owner, Method meaning through definitions-governance, and inherited DomainSpec meaning through the DomainSpec v2 owner until an exact adoption decision transfers it.
